nhl-playoff-format-again.title: Playoff Format
says: 16 teams will qualify for the Stanley Cup Playoffs.
The format is a set bracket that is largely division-based with wild cards.
Each of the four rounds is a best-of-7; the first team to win four games advances to the next round.
First-round winners within each bracket play one another to determine the four participants in the Conference Finals.
In the Conference Finals and Stanley Cup Final, home-ice advantage goes to the team that had the better regular-season record

years.2019: The 2020 playoffs: a 24 team playoff; a round robin of the top four of each conference for First Round seeding and a Qualifying Round of best of five series for the other eight; then First Round, Second Round, Conference Finals and Stanley Cup Final, each best of seven.

says: How the 24-team playoff format works
Round Robin: The top 4 teams play for First Round seeding (regular-season overtime rules in effect)
Qualifying Round: The remaining 8 teams play best-of-5 series to advance to the First Round (playoff overtime rules in effect)
First Round and Second Round: Format (seeding vs. bracket) and series lengths will be best-of-seven.
Conference Finals and Stanley Cup Final: Best-of-7 series will take place at Rogers Place in Edmonton.

nbc-2021-season.title: What we know about 2020-21 NHL season: Key dates, playoff format, more

years.2020: The 2020-21 season: 56 games, four realigned divisions, play only inside the division; the top four of each division make the 16 playoff clubs; first against fourth and second against third in each division; the winners meet in the second round; then the last four are seeded again; the Stanley Cup Final.

says: we know how the NHL plans to run its 56-game, 2020-21 season.
Instead, it’s quite simple: the top four teams from each of the four divisions will make up the 16 playoff squads.

From there, the top seed in each division faces the fourth seed, while the second faces the third. The winners face off in the second round. After the divisional bracketing is taken care of, the four remaining playoff teams will be re-seeded.
This could create some fascinating, one-of-a-kind matchups for the 2021 Stanley Cup Final.
nbc-2021-season.note: Drawn in Chromium on a GitHub runner on 2026-10-12. It names the second round and the Final, not the first round or the round of the last four.

nhl-2021-keyq.title: Key questions, answers on 2020-21 NHL season

years.2020: The 2020-21 season: a 56 game regular season; four new divisions and only games inside the division; the top four of each division qualify; the first two rounds inside the division, first against fourth and second against third in the first round; the four clubs of the Semifinal Round seeded by points; the traditional four round, best of seven format.

says: The NHL and NHL Players' Association announced Sunday an agreement to play a 56-game regular season beginning Jan. 13, 2021.
The playoffs, featuring the traditional four-round, best-of-7 format, are tentatively scheduled to begin May 11 and end no later than July 9
For the 2020-21 season, the teams will be realigned into four new divisions, and play will be limited to intradivisional games because of travel restrictions in the United States and Canada.

The top four teams in each division will qualify for the playoffs. The first two rounds of the playoffs will be intradivisional, with the first-place team facing the fourth-place team and the second-place team playing the third-place team in the first round.
The four teams that advance to the Semifinal Round will be seeded by their point total in the regular season

nhl-gm-overtime.title: NHL general managers discuss, endorse OT format at meetings
says: It introduced five-minute, 5-on-5 sudden-death OT for the 1983-84 regular season, but eventually the feeling was that too many games were still ending in ties.
The League went to 4-on-4 OT in 1999-2000 and began awarding a point to teams that lost in OT.

The shootout was introduced in 2005-06 as part of a comprehensive package of rule changes coming out of the 2004-05 lockout, but eventually the feeling was that too many games were ending in shootouts.
And so, the NHL went to 3-on-3 OT in 2015-16.

espn-overtime.title: What are NHL overtime rules?
says: Even with overtime in place, the league allowed games to end in a draw until 2005, when the introduction of the shootout in the regular season eliminated the possibility for a game to end in a tie.
Ties used to be a regular occurrence in hockey until 2005, when the NHL introduced the shootout following the end of overtime.
If neither team scores in the sudden-death overtime period, the game goes to a shootout.
This continues until one team scores and the other does not.
The extra point for an overtime/shootout loss was introduced in 1999, six years before the elimination of the tie.
